failures.rootCause: The agent spent its entire turn budget on environment setup and model introspection and never created the required deliverable module or its entrypoint function. It treated exploration as open-ended rather than time-boxed, so the trajectory ends mid-introspection with zero deliverable bytes on disk. No skeleton of the deliverable existed at any point, so partial credit was impossible. The same pattern appears in video-processing, raman-fitting and protein-assembly: exploration consumed the runway before the first write of the graded output.
failures.firstUnrecoverableStep: Agent halted after environment setup and model introspection; never wrote /app/pipeline_parallel.py or implemented train_step_pipeline_afab().

failures.rootCause: The agent ran a long fitting computation whose result existed only in the process's memory and stdout; the session ended before the final write, so results.json was never created. Because nothing was persisted incrementally, all completed work was lost rather than partially banked. A rough-but-valid result written early and then refined would have converted this into a pass or near-pass.

failures.rootCause: The agent excised dangerous substrings from CSS url() contents but did not check that what remained was still syntactically valid, leaving dangling 'url())' fragments. It validated the removal of the bad token instead of validating the resulting artifact in its own grammar. Deleting a span without re-parsing the surrounding construct is the recurring mechanism.
